items.mainDefect: Using && between the team admin and owner checks wrongly denies admins who are not owners.

secondary.defect: Any attendee matched by email can add guests, exceeding the organizer/admin permission model.

items.mainDefect: Case-sensitive existing-attendee deduplication allows differently cased versions of an existing email to be added.

secondary.defect: The blacklist comparison allows mixed-case guest emails to bypass blocked addresses.
Duplicate emails within the submitted guest list are not removed server-side.

items.mainDefect: Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails incorrectly treats filtered addresses as new guests.

secondary.defect: An unhandled calendar update failure after the database write leaves guests persisted while the request returns an error.

items.mainDefect: The blacklist comparison allows mixed-case guest emails to bypass blocked addresses.

secondary.defect: Case-sensitive existing-attendee deduplication allows differently cased versions of an existing email to be added.
The case-sensitive isAttendee comparison fails to recognize attendees whose email casing differs from the user's email.

items.mainDefect: Duplicate emails within the submitted guest list pass filtering and create duplicate attendees.

secondary.defect: The blacklist comparison allows mixed-case guest emails to bypass blocked addresses.
Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails incorrectly treats filtered addresses as new guests.

items.mainDefect: The always-truthy formatted error string prevents the unable_to_add_guests fallback from running.

secondary.defect: The error toast exposes raw tRPC codes to users.

items.mainDefect: Using && between the team admin and owner checks requires both roles instead of either role.

secondary.defect: The missing you_do_not_have_permission translation can cause the dialog toast to display the raw key.
